title: "Behold, the Nikola One in Motion." It Rolled Downhill.

lines.say: Behold, the Nikola One in motion. That was the caption in January twenty eighteen, on a video of Nikola's semi-truck cruising down a road.
lines.show: "Behold, the Nikola One in motion." That was the caption in January 2018, on a video of Nikola's semi-truck cruising down a road.

scene.q: Behold, the Nikola One in motion.
scene.cite: As quoted in SEC v. Milton, Complaint (S.D.N.Y. 2021) — allegations

lines.say: According to the SEC, the truck could not run under its own power. It was towed to the top of an incline and filmed rolling down.
Founder Trevor Milton had said it would be the first time anyone has seen the Nikola truck move. In twenty twenty-two, a jury convicted him of fraud.
lines.show: Founder Trevor Milton had said it would be "the first time anyone has seen the Nikola truck move." In 2022, a jury convicted him of fraud.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
